userStories.title: Create /lv-pulse skill file
userStories.description: Create .claude/skills/lv-pulse/SKILL.md with complete instructions for the autonomous blog post generation skill. The skill must have these steps: Step 1 — Load existing content inventory (read posts.json, topics.json, services.json, businesses.json to avoid duplicates). Step 2 — Research GSC/GA4 for content gaps (use mcp__gsc__search_analytics and mcp__gsc__enhanced_search_analytics for last 28 days, mcp__google-analytics__run_report for traffic data). Step 3 — Research social/web (WebSearch for Reddit r/toronto r/askTO, X/Twitter, Google news about Liberty Village last 30 days — run at least 7 search queries). Step 4 — Topic selection (cross-reference findings against existing content, score by search demand + recency + local specificity + content gap severity, select highest-scoring topic, output justification). Step 5 — Generate blog post content (all BlogPost fields, answerBlock 40-60 words, content 800-1200 words markdown, 4-5 FAQs with local details, cross-references to businesses.json names). Step 6 — Publish (read posts.json, append new post, write back with Write tool, verify). Step 7 — Build verification (npm run build, fix if fails). Step 8 — Output report (title, slug, category, why chosen, research sources, word count, build status). Include error handling: skip GSC/GA4 if no data, fallback to evergreen topics if no trending topics found, handle empty posts.json, revert if build fails twice. Include content quality standards: no fabricated businesses, verify against businesses.json, conversational tone, no AI self-references. Config: GSC sc-domain:libertyvillage.co, GA4 property 523614078, output to data/posts.json.
